item.title: SPIDER-web
item.description:
SPIDER-web is a shiny application that attempts to show scRNAseq data and in situ data from our SPIDER-Seq project. Home Page provides information about our project and how to use it interactively. Users can access our scRNAseq data through scRNAseq Page, and access our spatial-omics data through Spatial Page. 3D visualization Page provides interactive 3D visualization of the PFC transcriptome and projectome.

You can access our online website at https://huggingface.co/spaces/TigerZheng/SPIDER-web
